frequency_question: How often do executive nominations clear Senate structural friction to secure confirmation when opposed or heavily scrutinized within a short legislative timeline?
membership_rule: Includes all Cabinet-level and major agency head (FDA, CDC, EPA) nominations that faced procedural friction or delays in the Senate since 2017. Excludes uncontroversial routine judicial or low-level confirmations.

skeleton: Total contentious executive nominations requiring floor time divided by those successfully navigated through procedural friction within compressed calendars.
multiplier: 8 historical instances of high-friction executive/judicial confirmations tracked under Senate rules where 6 succeeded.
validity_reason: Senate procedural rules regarding cloture and committee hurdles remain stable through the current congressional term.
